scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 line-editing termless criteria (editing.insert-lines with ESC[1L and editing.delete-lines with ESC[1M, each at row 2 column 1 over four seeded rows) replayed byte-exactly on a disposable App and graded from parent-journaled readScreen stored cells of the whole screen, the cursor, the App's stored margins, origin mode and insert mode, and stored attribute details, with controls for the unmodified seed (no-op), the omitted, zero, two and oversized counts (observed), a full-height boundary at the second-to-last row, a DECSTBM scroll region with the cursor inside, above and below it, origin mode inside the region, and an attribute control (moved cells keep their stored tuple; new blank lines carry no attribute but a background; background fill observed, not required). Stored ASCII state only: the pinned terminal pixel path never carries a verdict and is not qualified; scrollback is observed on the alternate screen only; no Unicode, wide-cell or history qualification; no stock grades.
